meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成叙事性摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把项目聊天记录整理成每周故事式摘要。
copy.tagline_en: Generate weekly narrative digests of project history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn project chat logs into weekly story-like summaries.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按 ISO 周将项目历史拆分成多个章节，依次生成每周的叙事摘要，并自动传递上下文，使故事连贯。
howto.when: 当你要求“每周摘要”、“逐周故事”、“连续时间线”或“项目历史章节”时触发。

say.text: 请为我的项目生成每周摘要。
say.note: Claude 会按周拆分历史并生成多章叙事。

say.text: 给我这个项目的逐周故事。
say.note: Claude 会依次处理每一周，保持故事连贯。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude splits the project's timeline into ISO weeks and generates a narrative digest for each week sequentially, passing context from one week to the next for a coherent story.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

say_en.text: Generate weekly digests for my project.
say_en.note: Claude will split history by week and produce multi-chapter narrative.

say_en.text: Give me a week-by-week story of this project.
say_en.note: Claude processes each week in order, maintaining story coherence.
